headline: Big Cock Brock Drops a 49-Burger and Stroud Boys Forget Football Is Played On Sundays
subhead: Week 9 served up a 205-point coronation, a 2-point heart attack, and a Stroud Boys lineup that left more on the bench than most teams scored.
matchOfTheWeek: Browning Out 155.62, Christian McCalfinjury 153.42 — a 2.20-point thriller decided by King Unc himself, Joe Flacco, dropping 32.7 like he's 28 again. Meanwhile Wunder watched Jaxson Dart go for 27.24 on his BENCH while starting whoever the hell he started instead. That's not a loss, that's a self-inflicted wound you'll be explaining in therapy.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just put up 205 and is officially the team nobody wants to draw. Stroud Boys, meanwhile, are speedrunning the basement with 98 points and a bench that scored more than the starters.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top because Nick Celli is INSUFFERABLE this week and rightfully so. Big Cock Brock went for FORTY-NINE POINT THREE — that's not a tight end, that's a war crime. Pair that with Nail Polish Enthusiast going 38.7 and Madison Beer's Side Piece chipping in 28.7 and Nut Olave Your Face hung 199 on Little Peckers like it was a tutorial level. Tee Higgins went for 33 and it didn't matter. Big Papi, you got smoked by a guy whose QB paints his nails between drives.

T Swift's Baddies dropped 205.60 — the highest score of the week — and turned The Good Ladds into roadkill by 89. Drake London (38.8) and Colston Loveland (32.8) basically played 2K on rookie mode. Mig, your Jayden 1, Jayden 2, Jayden 3 collective couldn't outscore one Drake London. 3rd Overall Somehow threw up 28.82 and you still lost by 89. That's a structural problem, my guy.

Now let's talk about McBridesStrangeWhiteHock, who WON 128-98 and somehow had the most embarrassing box score of the week. Sam Darnold (28.2), 120% Kyler Brissett (24.84), and Tory Horton (20.8) all rotted on the bench — that's 73 points of QB you didn't need because you were playing the Stroud Boys, who scored 98. Bjewett left 37.3 on his own bench too. Two managers, one shared brain cell, and it was on vacation.

Rub My Chubb kicked QAmon's teeth in 164-113 behind Rico Dowdle's 28.1, while Kyle's Tiny-Handed Vampire and ShAmon-Ra couldn't drag him out of the dirt. He also pulled the trigger on Josh Downs mid-massacre, which is the fantasy equivalent of rearranging deck chairs while Dead Rat plays the violin.

OnlyFants handled Egbukkake 164-134 despite Szara hitting a perfect 100% lineup efficiency — Zach, you played the optimal version of a bad team. Then you traded for Kareem Hunt AND Deebo AND Tyler Shough in one week. Sir, this is a Wendy's.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Won the game and still found a way to leave 73 QB points and a Tory Horton 20-burger on the pine — coaching malpractice in a victory.

weeklyAwards.title: Crime Scene of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Got 28 from Josh Allen and lost by 89 — at some point you have to ask if all these Jaydens are actually one guy in a trench coat.

weeklyAwards.title: Stat of the Week: 49.30
weeklyAwards.blurb: Big Cock Brock outscored the entire Stroud Boys starting lineup minus their RB1 — let that marinate.

weeklyAwards.title: Lineup Roulette Loser
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 2.20 with Jaxson Dart's 27.24 stapled to the bench — Wunder, you had the answers on the test and turned in a blank Scantron.
